tagline: A slim outdoor wall box that puts a precise beam exactly where it is needed.
description: Linibox W is a compact rectangular wall light for façades, entrances and garden walls, aiming its light straight down. A row of small fixed optics sits flush in the underside, giving a crisp, low-glare beam from a narrow 17° spot to a wide 62° flood or an asymmetric 16°x30° wall-grazing lens. Three lengths share the same 95mm-high profile, so a run of mixed sizes still reads as one family.
specification: Exterior wall-mounted luminaire with fixed downward optics. CREE LED. Beam 17° | 21° | 25° | 35° | 62° | 16°x30°. UGR<13.7 (17°) | <13.1 (21°) | <12.5 (25°) | <20.6 (35°) | <23.6 (62°) | <15.7 (16°x30°). IP65. IK06. L90/B10 >50,000h. Integral 230VAC driver, non-dimmable or trailing-edge phase-cut dimmable. Supply cable 3×0.75mm², maximum outer Ø7mm. Other RAL colours on request.

tagline: A low, linear ceiling box for crisp outdoor downlight under eaves and canopies.
description: Linibox C is a slim rectangular surface-mounted downlight for soffits, porches and covered walkways. Its row of fixed optics delivers tightly controlled light, from a 17° spot to a 62° flood, plus an asymmetric 16°x30° lens for lighting along a wall. At just 46mm wide and 85mm deep in three lengths, it keeps a neat, architectural line on the ceiling.
specification: Exterior surface-mounted ceiling luminaire with fixed optics. CREE LED. Beam 17° | 21° | 25° | 35° | 62° | 16°x30°. UGR<13.7 (17°) | <13.1 (21°) | <12.5 (25°) | <20.6 (35°) | <23.6 (62°) | <15.7 (16°x30°). IP65. IK06. L90/B10 >50,000h. Integral 230VAC driver, non-dimmable or trailing-edge phase-cut dimmable. Supply cable 3×0.75mm², maximum outer Ø7mm. Other RAL colours on request.
